name: Phase-free multiply rule
summary: Two arity-1 standard H-boxes merged by a Z-spider give a phase-free Z-state.
description:
The special case $a = b = -1$ of the [multiply rule](../zh-multiply/): the arity-1 H-box is the state $|0\rangle - |1\rangle$, and multiplying two of these entrywise gives $|0\rangle + |1\rangle$, which is the phase-free arity-1 Z-spider. Classically, it can be read as $\neg\neg x = x$.

This is the form of the multiply rule that is an axiom of the phase-free ZH-calculus.
